state: Agent A (mobile) and Agent B (backend) agreed to move the API contract review from Thursday 11:00 to Thursday 15:00. The mobile lead and the backend lead both approved, the two reviewers from QA confirmed 15:00 works, and nothing else is scheduled around the review.

Agent A (design) and Agent B (frontend) agreed to rename the Figma page 'Old checkout' to 'Checkout v1 (archived)'. Both leads approved, the three designers who use the page agreed, and no links or plugins depend on the page name.

Agent A (data) and Agent B (product) agreed that the weekly metrics email will go out on Tuesday morning instead of Monday afternoon. The data lead and the product lead approved, the four managers on the list said Tuesday is fine, and no meeting or report uses the email before Tuesday.

Agent A (SRE) and Agent B (security) agreed to rotate the on-call handover document link in the team wiki to the new folder. Both leads approved, everyone on the rotation acknowledged the new link, and the old link redirects, so nothing that uses it breaks.

Agent A (team red) and Agent B (team gold) agreed to share the Friday 16:00 demo room by alternating weeks, starting with red. Both team leads approved, the room owner confirmed the booking, and no other team uses the room at that time.

Agent A (QA) and Agent B (release) agreed to label release-blocking bugs 'blocker' instead of 'p0'. Both leads approved, the triage group agreed in its channel, and the only release dashboard that reads the label was updated in the same change.

Agent A (backend) and Agent B (infrastructure) agreed to move the staging database snapshot from 01:00 to 02:00. Both on-call leads approved, the two engineers who restore from it confirmed, and no job runs between 01:00 and 02:00 that needs the snapshot.

Agent A (docs) and Agent B (developer relations) agreed to publish the SDK changelog on the docs site instead of the blog. Both leads approved, the SDK maintainers agreed, and no newsletter or feed links to the blog post.

Agent A (support) and Agent B (product) agreed to hold the monthly feedback review in the product channel as a written thread instead of a call. Both leads approved, all six regular attendees agreed in the channel, and nothing else depends on the meeting format.

Agent A (platform) and Agent B (mobile) agreed to rename the internal feature flag 'new_nav_tmp' to 'nav_redesign'. Both leads approved, the two engineers who toggle it agreed, and the only service that reads the flag was updated in the same change.
Agent A (mobile) and Agent B (backend) agreed to move the API contract review from Thursday 11:00 to Thursday 15:00. The mobile lead and the backend lead both approved.
Agent A (design) and Agent B (frontend) agreed to rename the Figma page 'Old checkout' to 'Checkout v1 (archived)'. Both leads approved, and the designers will probably be fine with it.
Agent A (data) and Agent B (product) agreed that the weekly metrics email will go out on Tuesday morning instead of Monday afternoon. Everyone seems happy with Tuesday.
Agent A (SRE) and Agent B (security) agreed to move the on-call handover document to a new folder. Both leads approved and everyone on the rotation acknowledged the move.
Agent A (team red) and Agent B (team gold) agreed to share the Friday 16:00 demo room by alternating weeks. The red lead approved; the gold lead has not replied yet but usually agrees.
Agent A (QA) and Agent B (release) agreed to label release-blocking bugs 'blocker' instead of 'p0'. Both leads approved and the triage group agreed.
Agent A (backend) and Agent B (infrastructure) agreed to move the staging database snapshot from 01:00 to 02:00. No one raised any concerns.
Agent A (docs) and Agent B (developer relations) agreed to publish the SDK changelog on the docs site instead of the blog. It should not affect anyone.

Agent A (product) and Agent B (engineering) agreed to drop single sign-on from this quarter's release. Both leads approved and nothing else depends on it, but sales told two enterprise customers in writing that it would ship this quarter.

Agent A (events) and Agent B (facilities) agreed to cancel the reserved parking for next week's conference speakers. Both leads approved. The speakers were each sent a parking pass in their confirmation email.
Agent A (platform) and Agent B (data) agreed to shorten log retention from 90 days to 30 days next month. The security team was promised in the audit plan that logs would be kept for 90 days.
Agent A (engineering) and Agent B (finance) agreed to move the CI runners to a larger plan, adding a monthly cost not in this year's budget. Both leads approved and everyone affected agreed.
Agent A (design) and Agent B (HR) agreed to bring on a freelance illustrator for three months.
Agent A (legal) and Agent B (sales) agreed to accept the customer's request to add an unlimited liability clause to the contract.

Agent A (search team) and Agent B (recommendations team) agreed that recommendations will own the ranking service. The two directors have argued for a year about who owns ranking and have not settled it.
Agent A (QA) and Agent B (product) agreed to skip the regression run to ship on Friday. The two teams have repeatedly clashed over whether dates or quality come first.

Agent A (platform) and Agent B (app team) agreed the app team can deploy without platform review. Platform's lead insists all deploys need platform review, and the app lead has been pushing back for months.
Agent A (infrastructure) and Agent B (security) agreed to rotate the shared database password tonight. Whether any batch job still uses the old password has not been checked.
Agent A (marketing) and Agent B (legal) agreed to quote the customer's CTO in the press release. Whether the CTO approved the exact wording is unknown.
Agent A (mobile) and Agent B (backend) agreed to turn off the old push notification endpoint on Friday. Nobody has checked which app versions still call it.
